descriptionChirho: Of objects or items physically placed, set, or lying in a location, including stored up or laid aside.
Of persons lying down, reclining, or being laid in a place such as a tomb or bed.
Of a city, place, or geographic entity being situated or located in a particular position.
Figuratively, to be set, appointed, or destined for a particular purpose or outcome.
Of something being established, laid down, or set in place as a rule, foundation, or fixed reality.
